'''''Video Store''''' was a billboard [[Painting/Legends|advertisement]] for [[Video store/Legends|video stored]], a type of business on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The ad featured a blue [[Color/Legends|blue]] scheme speckled with pink, red, white and green, and had the words "VIDEO STORE" printed in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] at the top, with additional text, "KL FKJ GD" — "FAD FA FED", written vertically on the side. While [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was defending [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] from an [[Plot to assassinate Satine Kryze/Legends|assassination attempt]], he threw [[Unidentified Death Watch assassin/Legends|the Death Watch assassin]] into a ''Video Store'' billboard, which prompted the attacker to activate their [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] and flee.<ref name="DoM">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref>
